ad_library.summary: Orizen Solar Innovations is running a live Telugu ad on Meta (Library ID 3529873930505195, started 18 September 2026, multiple versions) offering a Dussehra & Deepavali Dhamaka package - ₹78,000 subsidy, 3KW with ₹10,000 off, 5KW with ₹20,000 off, free panel-cleaning brush, WAAREE authorised channel partner - and every click goes to WhatsApp. The company is headquartered in Guntur with three AP offices (Guntur, Vijayawada, Tirupati) and is advertising into Telangana.

funnel.meaning: The paid click goes straight to a chat. Nothing is measured, nothing is retargeted, and the site's on-grid/off-grid/hybrid pages - all of them - never get seen by the buyer the ad paid for.

findings: Live Telugu ad (Library ID 3529873930505195, running since 18 September 2026, multiple versions) - the Dussehra & Deepavali offer sends every click to WhatsApp; orizensolar.com receives none of the traffic.
Three phone numbers across the funnel: the ad (8374 670 999 / 8374 683 999) and the site (+91 9962039859) - split numbers for one offer.
The live site still carries template text: the PM Surya Ghar blurb reads 'At Your Solar Partner, we are proud to support this initiative' - the company name was never filled in.

The features section is headed 'Features of Origin Solar Panels' - 'Origin', not 'Orizen' - and every 'Read More' service link points at '#' (the homepage anchor), so nothing on the site answers what the ad promises.
Guntur-based with offices in Vijayawada and Tirupati, advertising into Telangana - no Telangana service-area proof for the buyer the ad is aimed at.
next_steps: Put the Dussehra & Deepavali offer - ₹78,000 subsidy, 3KW/5KW discounts, WAAREE partnership - on a page you control, with name and phone captured before the WhatsApp hand-off.
'Your Solar Partner' in the PM Surya Ghar blurb and 'Origin Solar' in the features heading are the first trust breaks a visitor finds.
Every 'Read More' points at the homepage anchor - the on-grid, off-grid and hybrid pages exist in the nav but are unreachable from the homepage flow.
Unify the numbers and add local proof
One phone number everywhere, plus a Telangana service-area statement, turns a Guntur advertiser into a local option for the Telugu buyer.
